title: The Royal Kitchen Executions
summary: At Baelenys's command, every member of the royal kitchens is executed after the attempt on the King's life.
cause: Terrified that betrayal had reached his own table, Baelenys chose collective punishment before the poisoner or any accomplices had been identified.
consequence: Years of loyal kitchen servants die for one infiltrator's crime, deepening the Red Keep's climate of fear and destroying trust in the Crown's justice.

title: The Massacre at Oldtown
summary: Prince Gaelor's vanguard clashes with Oldtown's knights in the castle courtyard.
cause: The Crown's punishment for Hightower treason and the unresolved poison plot.
consequence: Oldtown loses two hundred knights, House Hightower is broken, and the Reach remembers the Crown's violence.

title: The Grand Tourney at King's Landing
summary: A grand tourney becomes a bloody contest of pride, assassination, and dynastic rivalry.
cause: The Crown seeks spectacle and reconciliation while old enemies use the lists as cover.
consequence: Neither prince can stand after the final tilt, and the attempted assassination turns public celebration into scandal.

title: The Mummers' Blood
summary: Gaelor kills two mummers with Blackfyre during a satire of the royal family. The trapped audience stampedes into the City Watch cordon.
cause: A satirical play enrages Gaelor, who orders gold cloaks to surround the tent before attacking the actors.
consequence: Twenty die: two actors and eighteen smallfolk (three children, four women and eleven men). Roughly a dozen more are badly wounded, and panic spreads through Flea Bottom.
